create_CIFAR10_dataset: create a CIFAR10 dataset instance with data_root and split set to train
create_CIFAR100_dataset: create a CIFAR100 dataset instance with data_root and download enabled
load_data_list_CIFAR10: load the CIFAR10 dataset images and ground truth labels from pickle files
check_integrity_CIFAR10: check the integrity of CIFAR10 data files using MD5 checksums
load_meta_CIFAR10: load category metadata from the CIFAR10 batches.meta file
